name: claude-router
description: Routes each prompt to the right Claude model locally, with exact version resolution.

enumDescriptions: Claude API with an API key stored in VS Code SecretStorage
Amazon Bedrock (Mantle) using the default AWS credential chain
Google Cloud Vertex AI using Application Default Credentials
Let the local classifier pick the family for each request
claudeRouter.pinnedFamily.description: Pin every request to one model family. A pin always wins over the classifier; a /prefix in the prompt still overrides it.

enumDescriptions: Prefer builds marked experimental in the registry when one exists
claudeRouter.releaseChannel.description: Which builds the Latest pointer resolves to.

enumDescriptions: Latest Pointer: always the newest stable Haiku
Pinned Snapshot: the version chosen in the Snapshot setting
Custom Model ID: the raw string in the Custom Model ID setting, sent as-is
claudeRouter.haiku.channel.description: How the Haiku tier resolves to a model version.

claudeRouter.haiku.snapshot.description: Haiku version used when the channel is Pinned Snapshot.

claudeRouter.haiku.customModelId.description: Haiku model string used when the channel is Custom Model ID. Sent to the provider without validation; retired IDs are mapped to the current Haiku.

enumDescriptions: Latest Pointer: always the newest stable Sonnet

claudeRouter.bedrock.region.description: AWS region for Bedrock. Empty uses AWS_REGION / AWS_DEFAULT_REGION.

claudeRouter.vertex.projectId.description: Google Cloud project ID for Vertex AI. Empty uses ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_PROJECT_ID.

claudeRouter.registryPath.description: Optional path to a models-registry.json that replaces the bundled one, so new model versions can be added without an extension release.
